$comment: Checked CI test-selection manifest (issue #2031). One entry per .NET test project the CI matrix knows how to run. select-dotnet-tests.sh loads ALL_TEST_PROJECTS from this file instead of a hardcoded bash array. `pathPrefixes` and `dependsOnProjects` document (for scripts/ci/tests/test-dotnet-test-manifest.sh and human readers) the mapping already encoded in classify_path()/main() in select-dotnet-tests.sh; they are NOT re-interpreted at selection time, so changing them here has no effect on which tests run for a given change -- see docs/CI.md for the authoritative bucket table. Projects with `shards` emit one matrix leg per shard as `<leg>-<shard>`; projects with an empty `shards` list retain their single `leg`.

testProjects.name: Farm.Moonraker.Emulator.Tests
testProjects.notes: Registered but not yet wired into a path-selection bucket (issue #2022) -- currently only exercised via the tests_other/full-safe fallback in select-dotnet-tests.sh. This manifest entry preserves that behavior; it does not change selection.

testProjects.name: Farm.Slicer.ProfileParsing.Tests
testProjects.notes: Registered but not yet wired into a path-selection bucket (issue #2022) -- currently only exercised via the tests_other/full-safe fallback in select-dotnet-tests.sh. This manifest entry preserves that behavior; it does not change selection.

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Abstractions.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2035 (Phase 7: Farm.Modules.Abstractions + IApiModule host seam). select-dotnet-tests.sh treats src/modules/** and src/tests/Farm.Modules.Abstractions.Tests/** as full-safe (modules/tests_modules buckets) rather than a narrower path-selection bucket, since the module host seam is foundational and every future Farm.Modules.* vertical slice will reference it.

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.SmartPlug.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2036 (Phase 8: the SmartPlug/PowerMonitor pilot vertical-slice module moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.SmartPlug, depending on Farm.Modules.Abstractions' IApiModule seam from #2035). Unlike Farm.Modules.Abstractions.Tests above, this project gets its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (smartplug/tests_smartplug) rather than full-safe, since it is a concrete leaf module with a single dependent test project -- the pattern later Farm.Modules.* phases (9-18) should copy. The retained CustomWebApplicationFactory-based integration test for /api/admin/power-monitors (AdminPowerMonitorsControllerTests) and RouteTableSnapshotTests both stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's smartplug bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module).

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.PrintQueue.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2040 (Phase 12: PrintJobManagementService and its 8 dependent controllers -- including SlicePrintBridgeController -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.PrintQueue, as-is/no internal decomposition, per the SmartPlug/#2036 vertical-slice pattern). Unlike SmartPlug, this module also references Farm.Slicer.Module directly (SlicePrintBridgeController consumes IArtifactsService/ISliceJobRepository) and Farm.Backend.Plugin.OctoPrint directly from its test project (PrintJobManagementServiceHistorySeedingTests), so select-dotnet-tests.sh's slicer and backend-plugin buckets also select this project, in addition to its own narrow printqueue/tests_printqueue buckets. The retained CustomWebApplicationFactory-based Dispatch/ integration suite and RouteTableSnapshotTests both stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so the printqueue bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg).

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Maintenance.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2037 (Phase 9: the Maintenance vertical slice -- Services/Maintenance/**, MaintenanceHub, the 5 Maintenance*Controller attribute-routed controllers, and their DTOs/Requests -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Maintenance, depending on Farm.Modules.Abstractions' IApiModule seam from #2035). Follows the Farm.Modules.SmartPlug.Tests pattern above: its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (maintenance/tests_maintenance) rather than full-safe. This phase additionally proves a SignalR hub can map from a module (MaintenanceHub is the first hub to move out of the host, via endpoints.MapHub in MaintenanceApiModule.MapEndpoints). Several CustomWebApplicationFactory-based tests for maintenance surfaces that did not move (e.g. MaintenanceHubAuthorizationIntegrationTests, MaintenanceScheduleDeploymentToolheadScopeTests, RouteTableSnapshotTests) stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's maintenance bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests.

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Calibration.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2038 (Phase 10: the calibration vertical-slice -- Services/Calibration, Services/Capabilities, calibration contract negotiation, and profile-resolution startup wiring -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Calibration, following the Farm.Modules.SmartPlug (#2036) leaf-module pattern rather than the full-safe Farm.Modules.Abstractions treatment). Depends on Farm.Infrastructure and Farm.Slicer.Module (for slicer-host calibration profile resolution). Gets its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (calibration/tests_calibration). The retained CustomWebApplicationFactory-based integration tests for calibration contract negotiation, the calibration health check, and RouteTableSnapshotTests all stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's calibration bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module).

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Devices.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2043 (Phase 15: the OctoPrint API-key auth service/handler/filter and 4 device-integration controllers -- NfcController, NfcDevicesController, CamerasController, and CameraSnapshotsController -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Devices, following the Farm.Modules.SmartPlug (#2036) leaf-module pattern rather than the full-safe Farm.Modules.Abstractions treatment). Admin/AdminHomeAssistantController, also listed in the issue body, had already moved to Farm.Modules.Administration by the time this phase merged (Phase 14, #2082, landed first and claimed it), so it is out of scope here -- a scope correction discovered only at merge time, not a deviation from the issue's intent. Depends on Farm.Infrastructure and Farm.Shared.Discovery (CamerasController's endpoint-detection dependency lives in the standalone discovery project, not Farm.Infrastructure). Gets its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (devices/tests_devices). The retained CustomWebApplicationFactory-based integration tests for camera snapshots, NFC device auth, and RouteTableSnapshotTests all stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's devices bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module). OctoPrintCompatController is explicitly out of scope and unchanged.

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Gcode.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2039 (Phase 11: Services/Gcode, Services/FileManagement, the 5 Gcode/harvest/promotion controllers, and their Chunk*/*Gcode*/MultiUpload*/Move*/DeleteFilesRequest DTOs moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Gcode, following the Farm.Modules.SmartPlug (#2036)/Farm.Modules.Calibration (#2038) leaf-module pattern). Unlike those two, this module needs AddSlicerModule ON (artifact-to-gcode promotion depends on the slicer module's repositories), so its own CustomWebApplicationFactory (Farm.Modules.Gcode.Tests/CustomWebApplicationFactory.cs) always registers the slicer module -- the epic's own note that a shared slicer-on HostFixture sub-fixture does not exist yet in Farm.Testing.Shared, so this factory is a narrow, purpose-built copy of Farm.Web.Api.Tests' own default (slicer-on) factory rather than a generalized shared fixture. Depends on Farm.Infrastructure and Farm.Slicer.Module/Farm.Slicer.Module.Api. Gets its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (gcode/tests_gcode). RouteTableSnapshotTests stays in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's gcode bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module).

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Identity.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2041 (Phase 13: Auth, users, API keys, quotas, roles, permissions, security audit, and password policy -- the 9 auth/admin controllers plus PermissionCatalogService/RolePermissionService/TokenRevocationCleanupService -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Identity, depending on Farm.Modules.Abstractions' IApiModule seam from #2035). Follows the Farm.Modules.Calibration.Tests pattern above: its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (identity/tests_identity) rather than full-safe. The 4 reflection-based architecture tests (AuthorizeRolesGateArchitectureTests, AnonymousEndpointArchitectureTests, NoClientsAllArchitectureTests, OpenApiAuthorizationTests), RouteTableSnapshotTests, and the genuine CustomWebApplicationFactory integration tests that exercise the assembled host (AuthenticationServiceIntegrationTests, AuthAuditServiceIntegrationTests, plus the Farm.Infrastructure-resident auth service unit tests under Services/Authentication/) all stay in Farm.Web.Api.Tests, so select-dotnet-tests.sh's identity bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module).

testProjects.name: Farm.Modules.Administration.Tests
testProjects.notes: New in issue #2042 (Phase 14: the Admin Control Center overview aggregation, admin data export/import, Home Assistant, and Telegram admin controllers, plus the settings and unified-settings controllers -- AdminOverviewService, AdminDataController, AdminHomeAssistantController, AdminTelegramController, AdminOverviewController, SettingsController, UnifiedSettingsController, and DiscoveryHeartbeatMonitorService (moved alongside UnifiedSettingsController, its only consumer, to avoid a circular Farm.Web.Api -> Farm.Modules.Administration -> Farm.Web.Api dependency, mirroring how Phase 13 moved TokenRevocationCleanupService) -- moved out of Farm.Web.Api into Farm.Modules.Administration, depending on Farm.Infrastructure and Farm.Settings.Abstractions). Follows the Farm.Modules.Identity.Tests pattern above: its own narrow select-dotnet-tests.sh buckets (administration/tests_administration) rather than full-safe. AdminDataControllerTests, UnifiedSettingsPerKeyPostTests, and UnifiedSettingsAnonymousAccessTests are full-host CustomWebApplicationFactory integration tests that stay dependent on Farm.Web.Api.Tests's internal configOverrides constructor (see AssemblyInfo.ModuleTestsVisible.cs), so select-dotnet-tests.sh's administration bucket also selects Farm.Web.Api.Tests (a controller-owning module keeps the API-tests leg, unlike a pure-service module).

testProjects.name: Farm.Web.IntegrationTests
testProjects.notes: Intentionally excluded from farm-web.sln by design (its csproj disables IsTestProject unless RunIntegrationTests=true); the workflow passes -p:RunIntegrationTests=true for this leg only. Must remain registered here even though it does not end in the literal '*.Tests.csproj' suffix and so is not auto-discovered by the manifest-completeness glob check.
